note: Rails secondary dialect deferred (D6447). Standard Rails is routes.rb `to: 'controller#action'` plus `app/controllers/*_controller.rb` — Phoenix-class cross-file resolve (ActionController, `render json:`, filters). Bounded inline `to: ->(env) { [status, headers, [body]] }` rack lambdas in one file were probed: ruby-ast-ingest (Sinatra `do…end` peel only) lifts route verbs but leaves 6/6 handler holes; closing 20/20 would require a new rack-triple + path_parameters/Rack::Request peel, not a cheap extension. Sinatra D6448-ST remains `hub-flagship-ruby`. Do not invent ActionController or LiveView-like UI.
